records.context: the event; resize, window-state, hide, show, move and application view-change types are acted on. Every event is passed on unfiltered: the filter returns False instead of calling the base class, because as an application-wide filter it can be handed a wrapper of the wrong type for an object being deleted, which made the base-class call raise and then crash the process.

records.source: the event; resize, window-state, hide, show, move and screen-change types are acted on. Every event is passed on unfiltered: the filter returns False instead of calling the base class, because as an application-wide filter it can be handed a wrapper of the wrong type for an object being deleted, which made the base-class call raise and then crash the process.
records.translation: el evento; se actúa ante los tipos de redimensionado, cambio de estado de la ventana, ocultar, mostrar, mover y cambio de pantalla. Todo evento se pasa sin filtrar: el filtro devuelve False en lugar de llamar a la clase base, porque, como filtro de toda la aplicación, puede recibir un envoltorio del tipo equivocado para un objeto que se está eliminando, lo que hacía que la llamada a la clase base lanzara una excepción y luego bloqueara el proceso.
